data.long_meaning: Derived from Old High German Hildebert, Hilbert means 'bright battle'. This name was popularized by Hilbert von Bork, a German theologian who lived during the 11th and 12th centuries. The name Hilbert carries the meaning “Bright battle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hilbert usually hope their child will grow to embody bright battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
